name: Skywork-VL-Reward-7B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.292 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-04-14. Caveats: a reward model, recorded with task other, not a generator - RewardBench/VL-RewardBench score pair preference, not generated text. On RewardBench it beats base on Score and Reasoning but LOSES Chat (90.0 vs 94.3) and Safety (91.1 vs 84.1). Both tables print the base row (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct) in the same table. Card is gated; read via r.jina.ai because /raw/ returns 401.
